title: AI37 A2A showcase extension v1
description: User-facing description of an agent for the product catalog (agents page and empty chat screen), embedded in Agent Card capabilities.extensions. The $id is an identifier, not a network endpoint. Text is the agent's own: norms must be verifiable, an empty list means the agent cites no norms and the surface prints nothing. Normalisation clamps over-long strings and drops malformed items instead of rejecting the card — only a missing title or summary makes the profile unusable.

capabilities.description: Modes of the agent drawn as separate showcase tiles. A caption, not a skill: it does not route. A tile may refer to a skill of the same card (`skill`); the catalog then shows it only to organizations that pass that skill's gate (`x-ai37.skills[skill].billing`) on top of the agent's own. Display order is array order. A malformed or repeated-id item is dropped, the profile survives; an empty list is omitted.

skill.description: Id of a skill in the same card whose `x-ai37.skills[id].billing` gates this tile. Normalisation checks the shape only and drops a malformed value; the catalog decides whether the skill exists.
